extracted.intended_audience: researchers preparing grant applications / applicants submitting materials to a funding opportunity (e.g., NIH)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on what kinds of blank instruments and scripts may be included in a grant application Appendix and the limits on Appendix use for review. Focuses on allowable examples (questionnaires, data collection forms, interview scripts) and procedural constraints regarding page limits and FOA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blank Questionnaire (allowable appendix material)
rubrics_metrics.description: A blank questionnaire would have fields formatted like these examples, below. This specific example is a questionnaire for study participants. Key features are free-form fields or tick boxes that the study participant can use to answer the questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This could be furnished to study participants on paper, electronically, or on-line but the key features of a blank questionnaire is a series of questions with a blank space in which participants can record the answers. (Example questions provided: e.g., hours slept, times waking, TV in bed, exercise, medications, snoring, prior diagnosis of sleep apnea.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Blank Clinical Data Collection Instrument (allowable appendix material)
rubrics_metrics.description: A blank data collection instrument would have fields formatted like these examples, below. This specific example could be used by members of an investigative team to report information about a study participant’s clinical history. Key features are free-form fields or tick boxes that members of the investigative team can use to record the desired data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This could be furnished to members of the investigative team on paper, electronically, or on-line but the key features of this blank data collection instrument is a series of variables with a blank space in which members of the investigative team can record the answers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview Script (allowable appendix material)
rubrics_metrics.description: An interview script would look similar to the information provided below. The key element is that it is a series of questions asked by members of the investigative team and directed at study participants. It could be easily formatted into a blank data collection instrument.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The interview script example is a straight series of participant-directed questions (e.g., questions about current medical history and past 12 months behaviors). It should not contain methodologic details used to train the interviewer or methods for analysis of the collected data, and it should be easily formatted into a blank form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix usage policy — required placement of review-essential information and FOA-specified items
rubrics_metrics.description: All information necessary for the review must be included within the page limits of the application and not placed in the Appendix, unless the funding opportunity announcement requires this information to be placed in the Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appendix materials that are not specified as required in the FOA may not be considered by reviewers; the review cannot be appealed if reviewers do not consider Appendix materials that are not specified in the FOA as required. Do not use the Appendix to circumvent page limits or to include review-essential material unless the FOA explicitly allows it.
